overview: AnimateDiff is the classic motion-module approach to text-to-video: it animates existing Stable Diffusion image models by inserting a trained temporal module, rather than training a video model from scratch. In this catalog it is a fully verified route — WorldFoundry's output matched the official RealisticVision scripts.animate demo exactly, down to file SHA256 and decoded pixel SHA256. The entry also answers to the aliases animate-diff and animate_diff.
overviewZh: AnimateDiff 是经典的「运动模块」式文生视频方法：通过在现成的 Stable Diffusion 图像模型中插入训练好的时序模块来让静态模型动起来，而不是从头训练视频模型。在本 catalog 中它是完整验证过的路径—— WorldFoundry 的输出与官方 RealisticVision scripts.animate demo 完全一致，文件 SHA256 与逐帧解码像素 SHA256 均精确匹配。条目同时响应别名 animate-diff、animate_diff。
architecture: A legacy U-Net latent diffusion backbone (Stable Diffusion v1.5) plus AnimateDiff's temporal motion module; the recorded checkpoints are guoyww/animatediff, the T2I backup repo, stable-diffusion-v1-5, and the CLIP ViT-L/14 text encoder. The catalog task list labels it explicitly as legacy-unet-diffusion to distinguish it from the newer DiT-based families.
architectureZh: 基座为旧式 U-Net 潜空间扩散模型（Stable Diffusion v1.5），叠加 AnimateDiff 的时序运动模块；记录的 checkpoint 包括 guoyww/animatediff、T2I 备份仓库、stable-diffusion-v1-5 与 CLIP ViT-L/14 文本编码器。 catalog 任务标签中特意标注 legacy-unet-diffusion，与较新的 DiT 系列相区分。
usageNotes: Runner parity is verified, so this is one of the safest video routes to start with. The Studio/API route runs in the unified environment after the recorded diffusers/transformers checkpoint-key compatibility fixes; per-run validation evidence is tracked outside the model catalog.
usageNotesZh: Runner parity 已验证，是入门视频生成最稳妥的路径之一。Studio/API 路径在统一环境中运行（已包含记录在案的 diffusers/transformers checkpoint 键兼容性修复）；每次运行的验证证据在 catalog 之外单独跟踪。

paper.title: Astra: General Interactive World Model with Autoregressive Denoising
paper.abstract: Recent advances in diffusion transformers have empowered video generation models to generate high-quality video clips from texts or images. However, world models with the ability to predict long-horizon futures from past observations and actions remain underexplored, especially for general-purpose scenarios and various forms of actions. To bridge this gap, we introduce Astra, an interactive general world model that generates real-world futures for diverse scenarios (e.g., autonomous driving, robot grasping) with precise action interactions (e.g., camera motion, robot action). We propose an autoregressive denoising architecture and use temporal causal attention to aggregate past observations and support streaming outputs. We use a noise-augmented history memory to avoid over-reliance on past frames to balance responsiveness with temporal coherence. For precise action control, we introduce

recipes.name: Being-H0.5
recipes.summary: Being-H0.5 is BeingBeyond's 2B-parameter cross-embodiment VLA policy.

notes: Being-H0.5 is a cross-embodiment VLA policy. It is intentionally routed through embodied action profiles, not video generation.

Official BeingHPolicy consumes multi-view RGB, robot state, language instruction, data_config_name, dataset_name, and embodiment_tag; output is robot-specific actions plus action_unified when RTC is enabled.
WorldFoundry keeps the flattened Being-H0.5 architecture and checkpoint runtime directly under worldfoundry/synthesis/action_generation/being_h05.
Safetensors are preferred; legacy .bin/.pt files use weights-only deserialization, require a pure named-tensor mapping, and load with strict key matching.
The default runnable profile uses data_config_name=libero_nonorm, dataset_name=libero_posttrain, embodiment_tag=libero, and checkpoint ${WORLDFOUNDRY_HFD_ROOT}/BeingBeyond--Being-H05-2B_libero.
The prior single-GPU OOM came from forcing Qwen3 dense attention through SDPBackend.MATH; Qwen3 dense inference now uses SDPBackend.EFFICIENT_ATTENTION for this profile.
Inference-only environment for the flattened Being-H0.5 runtime. It does not require datasets, trainers, DeepSpeed, or an editable source checkout.
The selected checkpoint and tokenizer/config assets must already be staged locally. Memory requirements vary by checkpoint and attention backend.

architecture: Per the publication (arXiv 2404.02101), camera poses are encoded as Plücker embeddings and injected through a trainable camera encoder attached to a frozen video diffusion base (AnimateDiff in the official release). paper.title: DUSt3R: Geometric 3D Vision Made Easy
paper.abstract: Multi-view stereo reconstruction (MVS) in the wild requires to first estimate the camera parameters e.g. intrinsic and extrinsic parameters. These are usually tedious and cumbersome to obtain, yet they are mandatory to triangulate corresponding pixels in 3D space, which is the core of all best performing MVS algorithms. In this work, we take an opposite stance and introduce DUSt3R, a radically novel paradigm for Dense and Unconstrained Stereo 3D Reconstruction of arbitrary image collections, i.e. operating without prior information about camera calibration nor viewpoint poses. We cast the pairwise reconstruction problem as a regression of pointmaps, relaxing the hard constraints of usual projective camera models. paper.title: FlashWorld: High-quality 3D Scene Generation within Seconds
paper.abstract: We propose FlashWorld, a generative model that produces 3D scenes from a single image or text prompt in seconds, 10~100$\times$ faster than previous works while possessing superior rendering quality. Our approach shifts from the conventional multi-view-oriented (MV-oriented) paradigm, which generates multi-view images for subsequent 3D reconstruction, to a 3D-oriented approach where the model directly produces 3D Gaussian representations during multi-view generation. While ensuring 3D consistency, 3D-oriented method typically suffers poor visual quality. FlashWorld includes a dual-mode pre-training phase followed by a cross-mode post-training phase, effectively integrating the strengths of both paradigms. Specifically, leveraging the prior from a video diffusion model, we first pre-train a dual-mode multi-view diffusion model, which jointly supports MV-oriented and 3D-oriented generation

overview: GeoCalib estimates camera calibration and the gravity direction from a single image by combining geometric optimization with deep learning. In this catalog it is a verified camera-calibration prior consumed by higher-level pipelines (notably VIPE) through the shared geometry-prior contract.
overviewZh: GeoCalib 通过几何优化与深度学习结合，从单张图像估计相机标定与重力方向。本 catalog 中它是已验证的相机标定先验，由上层管线（尤其是 VIPE）通过共享 geometry-prior 契约调用。
architecture: A neural network predicts geometric cues which a differentiable optimization layer turns into focal length and gravity estimates (per the upstream ECCV 2024 release). Registered at base_models/three_dimensions/general_3d/geocalib; apache-2.0.
architectureZh: 神经网络预测几何线索，可微优化层将其转化为焦距与重力估计（见上游 ECCV 2024 发布）。注册于 base_models/three_dimensions/general_3d/geocalib；apache-2.0。
usageNotes: It is integrated as an independent geometry prior under worldfoundry/base_models and exposed through the shared geometry-prior pipeline/operator contract. Higher-level pipelines (e.g. ViPE) import it from this canonical owner instead of keeping private copies. Runner parity is verified through the shared contract.
usageNotesZh: 它作为独立几何先验集成在 worldfoundry/base_models 下，通过共享的 geometry-prior pipeline/operator 契约对外暴露。上层管线（如 ViPE）从这一规范位置导入它，而不是各自保留私有副本。runner parity 已通过共享契约验证。
limitations: Single-image estimation: degrades on images without clear geometric cues (e.g. pure sky or texture-less walls).
limitationsZh: 单图估计：在缺乏几何线索的图像（如纯天空、无纹理墙面）上会退化。

inputs.default: A grand natural scene unfolds in an open landscape, beginning with a wide, distant view of a massive waterfall cascading down a towering cliff that dominates the frame, its immense scale emphasized by the surrounding rock formations and mist-filled air. From the cliff's edge, enormous volumes of water surge downward in continuous streams, breaking into layered sheets and turbulent ribbons as gravity accelerates the flow, while countless fine droplets are torn from the main body of water and dispersed into the air, forming a drifting veil of mist that catches the sunlight and shimmers faintly. The waterfall's surface exhibits complex motion, with faster central currents plunging straight down and thinner side streams clinging briefly to the rock face before peeling away, creating visible variations in speed, thickness, and texture. As the camera slowly advances forward and downward, the perspective tightens, bringing the lower section of the waterfall into clearer view, where the falling water collides violently with the surface below, generating bursts of white foam and outward-splashing sprays. The camera continues to move closer, transitioning into a medium and then near-field view of the plunge pool at the base of the waterfall, revealing a circular water basin whose surface churns constantly under the impact. Within the pool, swirling currents rotate in overlapping patterns, with darker, deeper green-blue water visible beneath the frothy white surface, and concentric ripples propagate outward toward the rocky edges. Individual droplets and splashes are now discernible, arcing briefly through the air before rejoining the pool, while fine mist rises continuously and drifts laterally with subtle air movement. Wet rock surfaces around the pool glisten under natural light, reflecting soft highlights that shift with the camera's motion. Throughout the shot, the camera movement remains smooth and deliberate, steadily closing the distance from the monumental wide shot to an intimate, detailed view of the water's surface, emphasizing the physical continuity of flowing water, gravity-driven motion, and the dynamic interaction between falling streams, airborne droplets, and the turbulent pool below.

notes: LingBotPipeline wraps the in-tree LingBot world runtime.
The official base-cam recipe uses eight GPUs with both DiT/T5 FSDP and Ulysses sequence parallelism.
Workspace also supports a four-GPU compact topology; both 4 and 8 divide the model's 40 attention heads.

On four A100 80GB GPUs, Workspace adapts the catalog default to T5 FSDP, replicated/offloaded DiTs, and Ulysses size 4. This exact topology completed all 70 denoising steps and produced a coherent 161-frame artifact on 2026-07-28.

A checkpoint-backed single-GPU full-quality run completed on 2026-07-28 with the official 161-frame, 70-step, 399360-pixel-area base-cam settings; all 161 frames decoded at 832x464 and 16 FPS with non-static, non-black content.

The public lingbot-world binding also validated the independent Fast weights with runtime_variant=fast and fast_model_path in the dedicated environment. The 21-frame output decoded at 544x720 and 16 FPS with changing content; longer Fast rollouts and camera adherence were not measured. Fast frame counts must be 12n-3 (9, 21, 33, ...) because upstream chunks three latent frames.
Runtime dependencies are declared in-tree; environment creation does not read an external LingBot repository checkout.
LingBot-World act2cam parity requires the dedicated official environment with flash-attn; the unified env produced near-black act2cam videos on the upstream examples/05 demo.
Exact torch and flash-attn pins intentionally keep this model out of unified runtime routing.

execute=True loads control.safetensors and dit.safetensors from WORLDFOUNDRY_HFD_ROOT or the bench-local ckpt/hfd fallback; every segment requires user-provided image/prompt/dense-depth/sparse-track conditioning.

overviewZh: LongVie 2 是 Vchitect 团队第二代可控长视频框架，也是本 catalog 中这对条目里已验证的一个： Studio 默认的四卡 torchrun USP 路径已于 2026-07-28 完成 checkpoint 加载运行，81 帧全部按 640x352 解码。它以排队的 81 帧控制视频分段生成，每次续写复用上一段末帧、八帧历史与噪声状态。
architecture: Built over canonical Wan roles (base: Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P) plus LongVie-specific weights: the adapter loads both control.safetensors and dit.safetensors — the latter is the LongVie 2 DiT attention override that distinguishes it from LongVie-1. architectureZh: 构建在规范化 Wan 角色之上（基座：Wan2.1-I2V-14B-480P），叠加 LongVie 专属权重：适配器同时加载 control.safetensors 与 dit.safetensors——后者即区别于 LongVie-1 的 LongVie 2 DiT 注意力覆盖。 execute=True 时支持官方 USP ring/ulysses 分布式推理。
usageNotes: Each queued segment needs a non-empty prompt plus dense depth and sparse pointmap/track control videos; the first segment also needs an image. Quality defaults: 81 frames at 16 FPS, 50 steps. The Studio profile uses four-rank USP with the complete model resident on each supported 80GB rank, and only rank zero materializes the artifact. This is queued segment generation, not keyboard realtime.

overview: Metric3D recovers metric-scale depth from a single image by normalizing images into a canonical camera space, which lets one model generalize across cameras. In this catalog it is a verified metric-depth prior: the VIPE SLAM defaults reference it by name through the shared priors factory, and checkpoint-backed inference runs through the geometry-prior contract.
overviewZh: Metric3D 通过把图像归一化到规范相机空间，从单张图像恢复米制尺度深度，使单一模型能够跨相机泛化。本 catalog 中它是已验证的米制深度先验：VIPE SLAM 默认配置通过共享先验工厂按名称引用它，checkpoint 加载推理经 geometry-prior 契约运行。
architecture: Per the upstream publication (ICCV 2023), a canonical-camera transformation resolves the metric ambiguity of single-image depth, and the recorded checkpoint is JUGGHM/Metric3D under a bsd-2-clause license. Registered at base_models/three_dimensions/depth/metric3d.
architectureZh: 按上游论文（ICCV 2023），规范相机变换消解了单图深度的米制歧义；记录的 checkpoint 为 JUGGHM/Metric3D，许可 bsd-2-clause。注册于 base_models/three_dimensions/depth/metric3d。
usageNotes: It is integrated as an independent geometry prior under worldfoundry/base_models and exposed through the shared geometry-prior pipeline/operator contract. Higher-level pipelines (e.g. ViPE) import it from this canonical owner instead of keeping private copies. Runner parity is verified through the shared contract; it is the default metric-depth choice in the VIPE SLAM configuration.
usageNotesZh: 它作为独立几何先验集成在 worldfoundry/base_models 下，通过共享的 geometry-prior pipeline/operator 契约对外暴露。上层管线（如 ViPE）从这一规范位置导入它，而不是各自保留私有副本。runner parity 已通过共享契约验证；它是 VIPE SLAM 配置中的默认米制深度选择。
highlightsZh: 公开的 Hugging Face 权重
limitations: Metric accuracy depends on camera-intrinsics quality; wrong intrinsics degrade the scale.
Single-image prior; temporal stability on video is out of scope.
limitationsZh: 米制精度依赖相机内参质量；内参错误会破坏尺度。
单帧先验；视频时序稳定性不在其范围内。

overview: MonST3R extends the DUSt3R pointmap approach to dynamic scenes: it estimates per-timestep geometry directly from video, recovering shape and motion without a static-scene assumption. In this catalog it is fully verified — the CUDA Studio job produced a valid GLB v2 scene with 51 geometries and finite point data on 2026-07-10 through the in-tree demo.py subprocess adapter.
overviewZh: MonST3R 把 DUSt3R 的点图方法扩展到动态场景：直接从视频逐时刻估计几何，在不假设静态场景的前提下同时恢复形状与运动。本 catalog 中它已完整验证——CUDA Studio 任务于 2026-07-10 通过树内 demo.py 子进程适配器产出含 51 个几何体、点数据有限的合法 GLB v2 场景。
architecture: Per the upstream publication, MonST3R fine-tunes the DUSt3R pointmap regressor on dynamic data so that pointmaps are estimated per timestep; downstream optimization aligns them into a 4D scene. WorldFoundry vendors the infer-time components in-tree and materializes a GLB scene artifact.
architectureZh: 按上游论文，MonST3R 在动态数据上微调 DUSt3R 的点图回归器，使点图按时刻估计；下游优化将其对齐为 4D 场景。WorldFoundry 将推理组件内置树内，并生成 GLB 场景产物。
usageNotes: The Studio default disables the optional flow loss so missing RAFT2/SAM2 assets do not block preview output. For full official dynamic-mask parity, configure the MonST3R, RAFT, and SAM2 assets in the runtime environment.
usageNotesZh: Studio 默认关闭可选的光流损失，因此 RAFT2/SAM2 资产缺失不会阻塞预览输出。若要完整对齐官方动态掩码效果，请在运行时环境中配置 MonST3R、RAFT 与 SAM2 资产。
highlights: Geometry Estimation In The Presence Of Motion
highlightsZh: geometry estimation in the presence of motion
limitations: Full official dynamic-mask parity needs RAFT2/SAM2 assets beyond the Studio default path.
Optimization-based alignment makes long videos slow compared with feed-forward reconstructors.
limitationsZh: 完整的官方动态掩码效果需要 Studio 默认路径之外的 RAFT2/SAM2 资产。

paper.title: NeoVerse: Enhancing 4D World Model with in-the-wild Monocular Videos
paper.abstract: In this paper, we propose NeoVerse, a versatile 4D world model that is capable of 4D reconstruction, novel-trajectory video generation, and rich downstream applications. We first identify a common limitation of scalability in current 4D world modeling methods, caused either by expensive and specialized multi-view 4D data or by cumbersome training pre-processing. In contrast, our NeoVerse is built upon a core philosophy that makes the full pipeline scalable to diverse in-the-wild monocular videos. Specifically, NeoVerse features pose-free feed-forward 4D reconstruction, online monocular degradation pattern simulation, and other well-aligned techniques. These designs empower NeoVerse with versatility and generalization to various domains. Meanwhile, NeoVerse achieves state-of-the-art performance in standard reconstruction and generation benchmarks. paper.title: ReCamMaster: Camera-Controlled Generative Rendering from A Single Video
paper.abstract: Camera control has been actively studied in text or image conditioned video generation tasks. However, altering camera trajectories of a given video remains under-explored, despite its importance in the field of video creation. It is non-trivial due to the extra constraints of maintaining multiple-frame appearance and dynamic synchronization. To address this, we present ReCamMaster, a camera-controlled generative video re-rendering framework that reproduces the dynamic scene of an input video at novel camera trajectories. The core innovation lies in harnessing the generative capabilities of pre-trained text-to-video models through a simple yet powerful video conditioning mechanism--its capability is often overlooked in current research. paper.title: SCOPE: Simulating Cross-game Operations in Playable Environments for FPS World Models
paper.abstract: Interactive world models for first-person shooter (FPS) games must resolve high-frequency overlapping control signals at every frame without disrupting unaffected regions. Existing methods inject actions globally and train on single titles, failing under dense FPS inputs. We observe that FPS actions are spatially selective: discrete events such as firing or reloading affect only a localized region around the weapon (the scope), while continuous camera and movement signals govern stable surroundings. We propose SCOPE, which inserts a conditioning module into each transformer block of a pretrained video diffusion model. It reshapes features into per-pixel temporal sequences so that each position computes its action response from local visual content. overview: Show-o (Xie et al., Show Lab at NUS with ByteDance, arXiv 2408.12528) is a single 1.3B transformer that unifies multimodal understanding and generation. It is initialized from Phi-1.5 and, unlike systems that attach a separate diffusion expert to an MLLM, uses one set of weights for both.

Text is discrete tokens modeled autoregressively (next-token prediction). Images are MAGVIT-v2 lookup-free tokens — a 256×256 frame becomes a 16×16 grid from an 8,192-entry codebook — then generated by MaskGIT-style discrete diffusion (mask-token prediction) with full attention. Omni-attention is causal on text and bidirectional on image tokens. The LLM itself encodes the text condition, so there is no extra T5/CLIP text encoder.

The same checkpoint, in the paper, does VQA and captioning, text-to-image, and text-guided inpainting or extrapolation without extra finetuning, plus mixed-modality sequences. Default generation numbers use 1.3B parameters and about 35M image-text pairs (MSCOCO FID-30K 9.24), close to a LLaVA-v1.5-Phi-1.5 understanding-only baseline. In this catalog only the T2I wrapper is wired; MMU, inpainting, and extrapolation remain future work.
overviewZh: Show-o（Xie 等，新加坡国立大学 Show Lab 与 ByteDance，arXiv 2408.12528）是一个 1.3B 的单一 Transformer，把多模态理解与生成放在同一套权重里。它从 Phi-1.5 初始化，而不是把独立扩散专家接到 MLLM 上。

文本是离散 token，用自回归 next-token prediction；图像经 MAGVIT-v2 无查找量化，256×256 变成 16×16、码本 8,192，再用 MaskGIT 式离散扩散（mask-token prediction）和全注意力生成。Omni-attention 对文本因果、对图像 token 双向。文本条件由 LLM 自己编码，没有额外的 T5/CLIP 文本编码器。
论文中同一套权重可做 VQA/配文、文生图，以及无需额外微调的文本引导补全与外推，也支持混合模态序列。默认生成数字是 1.3B 参数、约 3500 万图文对（MSCOCO FID-30K 9.24），接近只做理解的 LLaVA-v1.5-Phi-1.5 基线。本 catalog 只接通 T2I；MMU、补全与外推仍是后续工作。
architecture: The transformer is Phi-1.5 with QK-Norm on every attention layer. The embedding table grows by 8,192 learnable image-token rows. A unified prompt wraps the sequence with task markers [MMU] / [T2I], text bounds [SOT]/[EOT], and image bounds [SOI]/[EOI]. Training mixes mask-token prediction and next-token prediction (L_MTP + α L_NTP). Generation starts from all [MASK] tokens and iteratively unmasks over T steps — about 20× fewer steps than autoregressive image decoding; the in-tree runtime defaults to 256 px, CFG 3.0, and 18 steps.

Image I/O uses the MAGVIT-v2 VQ tokenizer (showlab/magvitv2). The paper also studies continuous MAGVIT or CLIP-ViT features for understanding (Show-o† / Show-o‡); the released default and these catalog weights use discrete tokens for both understanding and generation. WorldFoundry's runtime lives under synthesis/visual_generation/show_o with a mode/prompt/image contract and microsoft/phi-1_5 plus showlab/show-o.
architectureZh: Transformer 是带逐层 QK-Norm 的 Phi-1.5，词表额外增加 8,192 个可学习图像 token。统一 prompt 用 [MMU]/[T2I] 标明任务，用 [SOT]/[EOT]、[SOI]/[EOI] 框住文本与图像。训练同时做 mask-token prediction 与 next-token prediction（L_MTP + α L_NTP）。生成从全 [MASK] 开始、按 T 步逐步揭开，步数大约是自回归解码图像的 1/20；树内运行时默认 256 像素、CFG 3.0、18 步。

图像编解码用 MAGVIT-v2 VQ（showlab/magvitv2）。论文还试过把 MAGVIT 或 CLIP-ViT 连续特征用于理解（Show-o† / Show-o‡）；发布的默认权重和本 catalog 对理解与生成都用离散 token。WorldFoundry 运行时在 synthesis/visual_generation/show_o，契约为 mode/prompt/image，权重为 microsoft/phi-1_5 与 showlab/show-o。

Paper-default resolution is 256; the wrapper uses classifier-free guidance (default 3.0) and 18 discrete-diffusion steps. Weights are MIT at showlab/show-o, with MAGVIT-v2 and Phi-1.5 as recorded companions. Image understanding and editing modes exist in the paper but are not wired here.

paper.title: Show-o: One Single Transformer to Unify Multimodal Understanding and Generation
paper.abstract: We present a unified transformer, i.e., Show-o, that unifies multimodal understanding and generation. Unlike fully autoregressive models, Show-o unifies autoregressive and (discrete) diffusion modeling to adaptively handle inputs and outputs of various and mixed modalities. The unified model flexibly supports a wide range of vision-language tasks including visual question-answering, text-to-image generation, text-guided inpainting/extrapolation, and mixed-modality generation. Across various benchmarks, it demonstrates comparable or superior performance to existing individual models with an equivalent or larger number of parameters tailored for understanding or generation. This significantly highlights its potential as a next-generation foundation model. Code and models are released at https://github.com/showlab/Show-o.

paper.abstract: In this paper, we introduce Splatt3R, a pose-free, feed-forward method for in-the-wild 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis from stereo pairs. For generalizability, we build Splatt3R upon a ``foundation'' 3D geometry reconstruction method, MASt3R, by extending it to deal with both 3D structure and appearance. Specifically, unlike the original MASt3R which reconstructs only 3D point clouds, we predict the additional Gaussian attributes required to construct a Gaussian primitive for each point. Hence, unlike other novel view synthesis methods, Splatt3R is first trained by optimizing the 3D point cloud's geometry loss, and then a novel view synthesis objective. paper.title: VMem: Consistent Interactive Video Scene Generation with Surfel-Indexed View Memory
paper.abstract: We propose a novel memory module for building video generators capable of interactively exploring environments. Previous approaches have achieved similar results either by out-painting 2D views of a scene while incrementally reconstructing its 3D geometry-which quickly accumulates errors-or by using video generators with a short context window, which struggle to maintain scene coherence over the long term. To address these limitations, we introduce Surfel-Indexed View Memory (VMem), a memory module that remembers past views by indexing them geometrically based on the 3D surface elements (surfels) they have observed. VMem enables efficient retrieval of the most relevant past views when generating new ones. By focusing only on these relevant views, our method produces consistent explorations of imagined environments at a fraction of the computational cost required to use all past views as

paper.title: AC3D: Analyzing and Improving 3D Camera Control in Video Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Numerous works have recently integrated 3D camera control into foundational text-to-video models, but the resulting camera control is often imprecise, and video generation quality suffers. In this work, we analyze camera motion from a first principles perspective, uncovering insights that enable precise 3D camera manipulation without compromising synthesis quality. First, we determine that motion induced by camera movements in videos is low-frequency in nature. This motivates us to adjust train and test pose conditioning schedules, accelerating training convergence while improving visual and motion quality. Then, by probing the representations of an unconditional video diffusion transformer, we observe that they implicitly perform camera pose estimation under the hood, and only a sub-portion of their layers contain the camera information. paper.title: AlayaWorld: Long-Horizon and Playable Video World Generation
paper.abstract: Game worlds have traditionally been built through labor-intensive production pipelines, making them costly to develop, difficult to customization, and expensive to modify after deployment. Recent advances in video world models offer a fundamentally different paradigm. Rather than explicitly authoring every component of a virtual environment, these models autoregressively synthesize future observations conditioned on the current world state and user interactions, enabling playable worlds to be generated online. Trained on both gameplay recordings and real-world videos, they can capture diverse visual appearances and physical dynamics, opening new opportunities for interactive applications beyond gaming, including embodied intelligence. overview: ATI (Any Trajectory Instruction) turns trajectory drawing into video control: draw point trajectories over an input image and the Wan2.1-14B-based model animates objects, camera, or both along them. In this catalog only ATI's official inference delta is vendored — the unchanged Wan2.1 implementation is reused from worldfoundry/base_models.
overviewZh: ATI（Any Trajectory Instruction）把「画轨迹」变成视频控制：在输入图上画出点轨迹，基于 Wan2.1-14B 的模型就让物体、相机或两者沿轨迹运动。本 catalog 中仅内置 ATI 的官方推理增量——未改动的 Wan2.1 实现从 worldfoundry/base_models 复用。
architecture: Per the upstream release, ATI injects dense point-track conditioning into the Wan2.1 I2V backbone through a trajectory instruction module. Runtime checkpoint loading builds a read-only union of ATI weights (bytedance-research/ATI) and locally staged Wan2.1 I2V 480P base components.
architectureZh: 按上游发布，ATI 通过轨迹指令模块把稠密点轨迹条件注入 Wan2.1 I2V 基座。运行时 checkpoint 加载构建 ATI 权重（bytedance-research/ATI）与本地就位的 Wan2.1 I2V 480P 基座组件的只读并集。
usageNotes: Real 81-frame GPU inference is verified with local ATI and Wan2.1 I2V 480P checkpoints. Point-track accuracy and official artifact parity remain unmeasured. No source checkout or runtime download is permitted. Packed tracks have shape [N,121,1,3], with x/y pixel coordinates multiplied by 8; visibility may be normalized [0,1] or upstream quantized [0,8], consistently within each track.
usageNotesZh: 已用本地 ATI 与 Wan2.1 I2V 480P 权重验证真实的 81 帧 GPU 推理；点轨迹精度和官方产物一致性尚未测量。不允许源码检出或运行时下载。打包轨迹形状为 [N,121,1,3]，x/y 像素坐标乘以 8；可见度可用归一化 [0,1] 或上游量化 [0,8]，每条轨迹内部应保持一种编码。

overview: Bernini is ByteDance's unified any-to-any visual generation model: one checkpoint covers text-to-image, image editing, text-to-video, video-to-video, and reference-guided video. This flagship entry serves the full ByteDance/Bernini-Diffusers checkpoint, which pairs a 7B semantic planner with a 14B renderer. WorldFoundry vendors the official inference source in-tree and loads the self-contained Diffusers checkpoint directly — no external Bernini checkout is used.
overviewZh: Bernini 是字节跳动的统一「任意到任意」视觉生成模型：一个 checkpoint 同时覆盖文生图、图像编辑、文生视频、视频到视频与参考引导视频。本旗舰条目对应完整的 ByteDance/Bernini-Diffusers checkpoint，内含 7B 语义规划器与 14B 渲染器。WorldFoundry 将官方推理源码内置于树内，直接加载自包含的 Diffusers checkpoint——不依赖外部 Bernini 检出。
architecture: Two-stage design recorded in the manifest: a 7B semantic planner produces an intermediate plan and a 14B renderer synthesizes the final pixels. Official recipes run single-request inference with 8-way Ulysses sequence parallelism (nproc_per_node=8, ulysses_size=8). The task_type input selects among the six recorded task families at request time.
architectureZh: manifest 记录的是两段式设计：7B 语义规划器先产出中间规划，14B 渲染器再合成最终像素。官方配方使用单请求 8 路 Ulysses 序列并行推理（nproc_per_node=8、ulysses_size=8）。请求时通过 task_type 输入在六类已记录任务间切换。
usageNotes: Integration is complete but runner parity is pending_gpu_validation: the official 8-GPU Ulysses dispatch is implemented, and artifact parity still requires staged weights plus H100-class GPUs. If you do not have an 8-GPU node, use the Bernini-R renderer-only entries instead — the 1.3B one runs on a single GPU.
usageNotesZh: 集成已完成，但 runner parity 为 pending_gpu_validation：官方 8 卡 Ulysses 调度已实现，产物一致性仍需就位权重并使用 H100 级 GPU 验证。如果没有 8 卡节点，请改用 Bernini-R 渲染器条目——其中 1.3B 版单卡可跑。

paper.title: Bernini: Latent Semantic Planning for Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and diffusion models have each reached remarkable maturity: MLLMs excel at reasoning over heterogeneous multimodal inputs with strong semantic grounding, while diffusion models synthesize images and videos with photorealistic fidelity. We argue that these two families can be unified through a simple division of labor: MLLMs perform semantic planning, while diffusion models render pixels from high-level semantic guidance and low-level visual features. Building on this idea, we propose Bernini, a unified framework for video generation and editing. An MLLM-based planner predicts the target semantic representation directly in the ViT embedding space, and a DiT-based renderer synthesizes pixels conditioned on this plan, augmented by text features and, for editing, source VAE features for detail preservation. paper.title: Bernini: Latent Semantic Planning for Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and diffusion models have each reached remarkable maturity: MLLMs excel at reasoning over heterogeneous multimodal inputs with strong semantic grounding, while diffusion models synthesize images and videos with photorealistic fidelity. We argue that these two families can be unified through a simple division of labor: MLLMs perform semantic planning, while diffusion models render pixels from high-level semantic guidance and low-level visual features. Building on this idea, we propose Bernini, a unified framework for video generation and editing. An MLLM-based planner predicts the target semantic representation directly in the ViT embedding space, and a DiT-based renderer synthesizes pixels conditioned on this plan, augmented by text features and, for editing, source VAE features for detail preservation. paper.title: Causal Forcing: Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation Done Right for High-Quality Real-Time Interactive Video Generation
paper.abstract: To achieve real-time interactive video generation, current methods distill pretrained bidirectional video diffusion models into few-step autoregressive (AR) models, facing an architectural gap when full attention is replaced by causal attention. However, existing approaches do not bridge this gap theoretically. They initialize the AR student via ODE distillation, which requires frame-level injectivity, where each noisy frame must map to a unique clean frame under the PF-ODE of an AR teacher. Distilling an AR student from a bidirectional teacher violates this condition, preventing recovery of the teacher's flow map and instead inducing a conditional-expectation solution, which degrades performance. To address this issue, we propose Causal Forcing, which uses an autoregressive teacher for ODE initialization to bridge the architectural gap, and then applies the same DMD procedure as in Self

architecture: Cognition and action are separated: the VLM encodes image+instruction, then a DiT (diffusion transformer) action model predicts a 16x7 action chunk. The official demo contract is load_vla(...).predict_action(image, prompt, unnorm_key, cfg_scale, use_ddim, num_ddim_steps).
architectureZh: 认知与动作分离：VLM 编码图像+指令，DiT（扩散 transformer）动作模型预测 16x7 动作块。官方 demo 契约为 load_vla(...).predict_action(image, prompt, unnorm_key, cfg_scale, use_ddim, num_ddim_steps)。

overview: Diffusion Policy is the landmark visuomotor policy that models action generation as conditional denoising diffusion, substantially improving multimodal action distributions over regression policies. overviewZh: Diffusion Policy 是里程碑式的视觉运动策略：将动作生成建模为条件去噪扩散，相比回归策略大幅改进多模态动作分布。WorldFoundry 内置其低维 PushT 变体，从离线转换、完全解析的配置与纯张量 state dict 重建。
architecture: A denoising diffusion model over action sequences conditioned on observations. The in-tree runtime is the released low-dimensional PushT policy; the converted checkpoint passed weights-only reload, strict model/EMA restoration, CPU loading, and a finite GPU action probe.
architectureZh: 在观测条件下对动作序列做去噪扩散。树内运行时为发布的低维 PushT 策略；转换后的 checkpoint 通过了 weights-only 重载、严格 model/EMA 恢复、CPU 加载与有限 GPU 动作探针。
usageNotes: The executable dill workspace checkpoint is rejected at runtime with no unsafe deserialization fallback — conversion must happen once in a trusted offline environment. The predict_action route emits the configured low-dimensional PushT action schema.
usageNotesZh: 可执行的 dill workspace checkpoint 在运行时被拒绝，且无不安全反序列化回退——转换必须在可信离线环境中一次性完成。predict_action 路由输出配置的低维 PushT 动作 schema。
limitations: Only the low-dimensional PushT variant is vendored; image-based variants are not in-tree.

paper.title: Déjà View: Looping Transformers for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction
paper.abstract: Recent feed-forward 3D reconstruction transformers have scaled to over a billion parameters, following the broader trend of increasing model capacity in computer vision. Yet emerging evidence suggests that contiguous transformer layers often behave like repeated applications of similar operations, and multi-view reconstruction transformers refine their predictions progressively across decoder depth. We posit that model depth partially buys iteration, paid for inefficiently in unique parameters, and instead make that iteration explicit in architecture. Our model, DéjàView, applies a single looped transformer block recurrently to per-view features for K refinement steps. architecture: Per the Echo-Memory release (arXiv 2606.09803), every variant is a Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-based interactive world model that differs only in its memory mechanism. The sampler uses target-noise plus clean-context suffix, target-only CFG, context relocking after every solver step, and target-only decode.

paper.title: Echo-Memory: A Controlled Study of Memory in Action World Models
paper.abstract: We present \textbf{Echo-Memory}, a controlled study of memory mechanisms in action-conditioned world models. These models generate multi-segment videos from a first frame, text prompt, and camera-action sequence, but their central failure is often memory rather than local image synthesis: after the camera leaves and returns, the scene or salient object may silently change. Existing memory designs are hard to compare because gains are entangled with backbone, training, retrieval, and evaluation differences. Echo-Memory fixes the action-to-video interface and varies only how history is stored and read by the generator. Under a shared video diffusion backbone, optimizer, camera-action representation, sampler, and evaluation pipeline, we compare raw context, compression-based memory, spatial summaries with different read-out paths, and state-space recurrence. overview: FramePack is a low-memory approach to long image-to-video generation: it packs input frame context into fixed-length representations so generation cost stays roughly constant as the video grows. overviewZh: FramePack 是面向长视频图生视频的低显存方案：它把输入帧上下文压缩进定长表示，使生成成本不随视频变长而显著增长。WorldFoundry 在树内内置了最小化的仅推理 FramePack 运行时，集成状态标记为 verified——该路径通过共享 pipeline 契约产出官方风格输出。
architecture: FramePack (from the authors of ControlNet at Stanford) wraps a video diffusion backbone with a frame-context packing scheme that keeps a constant-length conditioning window, enabling minute-scale clips on modest VRAM. architectureZh: FramePack（作者来自斯坦福，ControlNet 团队）在视频扩散基座外包了一层帧上下文打包机制，维持定长条件窗口，使得在有限显存上也能生成分钟级视频。本仓库记录了位于 synthesis/visual_generation/framepack 的仅推理运行时与 prompt+image 输入契约。

overview: GEN3C generates camera-controlled video with an explicit 3D cache: it builds a rough 3D scene from the input image (via depth), warps it along the requested camera path, and lets the video model fill in the rest — precise camera control with 3D consistency (CVPR 2025). In this catalog it is assembled natively through the same denoiser/conditioner/scheduler contracts as the Cosmos Predict1 family.

overviewZh: Hailuo 2.3（海螺 2.3）是 MiniMax 的托管视频生成服务，本 catalog 将其记录为图生视频与音视频联合生成两类任务。你提供一张起始图（可附文本提示词），它在 MiniMax 的基础设施上渲染出成片—— WorldFoundry 本身不运行该模型。该条目还登记了 minimax-i2v、minimax_i2v 两个别名，旧配置可以继续解析。适合在不管理 GPU 的前提下，把 MiniMax 的生产级生成质量接入 WorldFoundry 的 Studio 工作流。
architecture: This is a hosted, provider-operated model: the vendor has not published its architecture, parameter count, or training recipe, and this repository does not record them. usageNotes: The catalog marks this entry as integrated: the hosted-API Studio pipeline is available, but you must supply your own provider API key and account. No weights are downloaded and no GPU environment is provisioned locally — generation happens on the provider side, so cost, quota, and content policy follow your provider account. Point the pipeline at your MiniMax platform key before launching jobs.
usageNotesZh: Catalog 将该条目标记为 integrated：托管 API 的 Studio pipeline 已可用，但你必须自备服务方的 API key 与账号。本地不会下载任何权重、也不会创建 GPU 环境——生成在服务方完成，费用、配额与内容政策均以你的服务方账号为准。启动任务前，请先在 pipeline 中配置你的 MiniMax 开放平台 key。

Helios follows its official PyTorch 2.10 and source Diffusers environment rather than the shared environment. The former Helios feature repository was removed; this profile pins the public head of the official Diffusers Helios PR (#13208) until it lands on main.

recipes.name: HunyuanWorld-Voyager
recipes.summary: HunyuanWorld-Voyager generates RGB-D video along camera paths. WorldFoundry's public runner has generated the official case1 example through a bridge to the licensed upstream checkout.

notes: The in-tree bridge calls a separate official checkout at revision 6218ccd36df77d0254dcf24ad1fb77312f75b04a; Tencent's community-licensed source and weights are not redistributed in this package.

Set WORLDFOUNDRY_VOYAGER_SOURCE_ROOT to that checkout and WORLDFOUNDRY_VOYAGER_PYTHON to an environment with the official dependencies; the bridge validates source, checkpoints, and a 49-frame condition directory.
Camera motion must already be rendered into the 49-frame condition directory. A raw image or action sequence alone is not a supported input.

The official case1 checkpoint generated an RGB-D MP4 on one H100 at 8 steps; the public runner generated RGB-D MP4s at 1 and 8 steps. All decoded as 45 frames at 768x1024 and 24 fps. The upstream pipeline drops four conditioning frames and removes a 16-pixel separator from its internal RGB-D frame.

The public runner also completed the upstream case1 50-step single-GPU default on H100 GPU2; its RGB-D output decoded 45/45 frames and visibly advanced toward the well. This does not measure metric depth or calibrated camera-pose accuracy.
The upstream Tencent HunyuanWorld-Voyager Community License excludes use in the EU, UK, and South Korea and requires its LICENSE and NOTICE on redistribution.
Default unified WorldFoundry runtime for modern NVIDIA hosts. Install with `bash scripts/setup/unified_install.sh`.
Override tier with `--cuda cu124` or `--cuda cu121` when an upstream model still pins an older CUDA wheel bucket.
Source the environment file emitted by `scripts/setup/unified_install.sh` so WORLDFOUNDRY_USE_UNIFIED_ENV=1 routes compatible profiles here.
Runnable GPU models that previously used cu113/cu118/cu124 CUDA buckets are mapped to this tier when they do not carry hard ABI pins requiring isolation.

Source code is Apache-2.0; adapter and base weights use the MiniMax H3 Community License.

paper.title: Geometric Context Transformer for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
paper.abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction aims to recover 3D information, such as camera poses and point clouds, from a video stream, which necessitates geometric accuracy, temporal consistency, and computational efficiency. Motivated by the principles of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), we introduce LingBot-Map, a feed-forward 3D foundation model for reconstructing scenes from streaming data, built upon a geometric context transformer (GCT) architecture. A defining aspect of LingBot-Map lies in its carefully designed attention mechanism, which integrates an anchor context, a pose-reference window, and a trajectory memory to address coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction, respectively. This design keeps the streaming state compact while retaining rich geometric context, enabling stable efficient inference at around 20 FPS on 518 x 378 resolution inputs

notes: The runtime owns only inference code. Rewriter and training surfaces are outside this integration.
T2I produces an image despite the default runtime profile artifact being the T2V video route.
The upstream recommended stack requires a dedicated Transformers 5 / Diffusers 0.39 environment.
The released Dense 1.3B checkpoint has a 121-frame, 832x480 quality-oriented Workspace artifact.

The released MoE 30B-A3B main transformer, 8.88GB text encoder, and FP32 VAE completed a real single-A100 Workspace run with the optional refiner disabled. The one-step smoke produced five fully decodable 192x320 frames (artifact SHA256 4458abda4089e0019587ab388f6ce10f47964af3033f32e060729ddb961ad7f7), proving the large-checkpoint execution path only; its visibly blurred output is not a quality demo.

A second MoE Workspace run used 20 denoising steps for nine 256x416 frames. Its first, middle, and last frames show a coherent industrial workbench, black robot mechanism, and red block without the one-step blur; artifact SHA256 is b3211b8ece8a73519bb7c3589cbeebf8c59b4cc473c86cc0e630f833dad2c6f3. This is a quality-oriented short smoke, not parity with the official 480x832, 121-frame, 40-step recipe.

The MoE single-device path is physically validated on A100 80GB and H100 80GB. On H100, a public 480x832, 25-frame, 20-step T2V run produced a fully decodable video without the refiner; its small-toy-car output remains a prompt-specific quality concern, and peak observed memory was 80,991 MiB (about 79.1 GiB) on an H100 reporting 81,559 MiB total.

The pinned official script and in-tree runner each produced a coherent 25-frame, 832x480 T2V video from official example 1 with only duration shortened from five to one second, 40 steps and matching seed. overviewZh: Luma Ray2 是 Luma AI 的托管视频生成模型，catalog 记录其文生视频与图生视频能力。 WorldFoundry 的 Studio pipeline 封装了 Luma API：一条提示词或一帧起始图，最终以标准 WorldFoundry 结果目录中的可下载视频呈现。模型本身完全不在本地运行；该条目承担的是托管路径的记录与管道工作。
architecture: This is a hosted, provider-operated model: the vendor has not published its architecture, parameter count, or training recipe, and this repository does not record them. What WorldFoundry records is the integration surface only — a Studio pipeline that submits requests to the provider endpoint and collects the returned video artifacts.
architectureZh: 这是由服务方托管运行的模型：厂商未公开其架构、参数规模或训练细节，本仓库也未记录这些信息。WorldFoundry 记录的只是集成层——一条向服务方端点提交请求并回收生成视频产物的 Studio pipeline。
usageNotes: The catalog marks this entry as integrated: the hosted-API Studio pipeline is available, but you must supply your own provider API key and account. No weights are downloaded and no GPU environment is provisioned locally — generation happens on the provider side, so cost, quota, and content policy follow your provider account. Keys are issued through Luma's developer platform (lumalabs.ai).
usageNotesZh: Catalog 将该条目标记为 integrated：托管 API 的 Studio pipeline 已可用，但你必须自备服务方的 API key 与账号。本地不会下载任何权重、也不会创建 GPU 环境——生成在服务方完成，费用、配额与内容政策均以你的服务方账号为准。API key 通过 Luma 开发者平台（lumalabs.ai）签发。

paper.title: Multiplayer Interactive World Models with Representation Autoencoders
paper.abstract: We introduce the first multiplayer world model for highly dynamic environments governed by complex physical interactions. Whereas single-player world models treat the other agents as part of the environment, ours conditions on the action streams of multiple agents, learning to attribute changes in the scene to the correct player and to stay coherent under arbitrary combinations of their actions. We study this problem in the game of Rocket League, where players compete and cooperate under fast, tightly coupled dynamics. Trained on 10,000 hours of gameplay collected with publicly available bots, our 5-billion-parameter latent diffusion model generates four-player matches in real time, producing 20 frames per second on a single Nvidia B200 GPU. Although trained only on short clips, its rollouts stay stable far beyond the training horizon: distributional quality holds steady out to five minu

paper.title: MVDiffusion: Enabling Holistic Multi-view Image Generation with Correspondence-Aware Diffusion
paper.abstract: This paper introduces MVDiffusion, a simple yet effective method for generating consistent multi-view images from text prompts given pixel-to-pixel correspondences (e.g., perspective crops from a panorama or multi-view images given depth maps and poses). Unlike prior methods that rely on iterative image warping and inpainting, MVDiffusion simultaneously generates all images with a global awareness, effectively addressing the prevalent error accumulation issue. At its core, MVDiffusion processes perspective images in parallel with a pre-trained text-to-image diffusion model, while integrating novel correspondence-aware attention layers to facilitate cross-view interactions. For panorama generation, while only trained with 10k panoramas, MVDiffusion is able to generate high-resolution photorealistic images for arbitrary texts or extrapolate one perspective image to a 360-degree view. The in-tree policy server preserves the official DROID/RoboArena observation mapping: two external cameras, wrist camera, joint position, gripper position, prompt, and session_id.

WorldFoundry keeps the inference-only DreamZero server/model implementation directly in worldfoundry/synthesis/action_generation/dreamzero. The wrapper builds an in-tree torch.distributed server command and the live client invokes its WebSocket inference protocol.

The BasePolicy contract, NumPy msgpack codec, and distributed observation serialization are local and pickle-free; no openpi-client, editable checkout, PYTHONPATH injection, or runtime asset download is used.
Checkpoint-backed GPU execution requires a staged DROID/AgiBot checkpoint and a compatible CUDA 12.9 topology; this hardware boundary is separate from the verified import/protocol/runtime contracts.

NumPy msgpack encoding and the policy server interface are implemented in-tree. Checkpoints, tokenizer assets, and experiment_cfg/conf.yaml must already be staged locally.
The default 14B server profile launches two CUDA ranks. The Wan2.2 5B entrypoint can use one rank; checkpoint architecture and available GPU memory determine the supported topology.
Flash Attention and TensorRT are optional local accelerators. TensorRT is imported only when LOAD_TRT_ENGINE is set; neither package nor an engine is downloaded at runtime.

The in-tree policy server preserves the official DROID/RoboArena observation mapping: two external cameras, wrist camera, joint position, gripper position, prompt, and session_id.

The integrated DreamZeroSynthesis can run the official default WebSocket client against an already running DreamZero server via dreamzero_server_host/server_host and dreamzero_server_port/server_port; it does not use the shared OfficialRuntime pipeline.

WorldFoundry keeps the inference-only DreamZero server/model implementation directly in worldfoundry/synthesis/action_generation/dreamzero. The wrapper builds an in-tree torch.distributed server command and the live client invokes its WebSocket inference protocol.

The BasePolicy contract, NumPy msgpack codec, and distributed observation serialization are local and pickle-free; no openpi-client, editable checkout, PYTHONPATH injection, or runtime asset download is used.
Checkpoint-backed GPU execution requires a staged DROID/AgiBot checkpoint and a compatible CUDA 12.9 topology; this hardware boundary is separate from the verified import/protocol/runtime contracts.

architecture: Two parts recorded in-tree: the lookup-free quantization (LFQ) tokenizer with a very large codebook, and an autoregressive transformer that predicts visual tokens for a requested ImageNet class. The class_id input selects the category; generation runs the vendored CUDA wrapper.
architectureZh: 树内记录两部分：带超大码本的免查表量化（LFQ）分词器，以及为指定 ImageNet 类别预测视觉 token 的自回归 Transformer。class_id 输入选择类别；生成通过内置 CUDA 封装执行。
usageNotes: Runner status is checkpoint_backed_verified — this route actually ran on GPU with the TencentARC/Open-MAGVIT2 weights (apache-2.0). Keep expectations scoped: it is class-conditional image generation, not prompt-to-video; video tokenization is what the tokenizer supports upstream.

architectureZh: 按论文，极线 Transformer 消解两视图间的尺度歧义，网络预测高斯参数的概率分布。 WorldFoundry 将源码内置于 base_models/three_dimensions/point_clouds/pixelsplat，并对官方测试入口做惰性封装（MIT 许可；checkpoint 镜像 dylanebert/pixelSplat）。
usageNotes: Provide model_path pointing to re10k.ckpt or acid.ckpt, the matching experiment, and posed dataset_roots/index_path. Install the declared runtime dependencies and local Gaussian rasterizer. Bare image lists use a synthetic baseline. PLY output exports normalized geometry and DC color with standard opacity logits.
usageNotesZh: model_path 指向 re10k.ckpt 或 acid.ckpt，同时指定匹配的 experiment 与标定数据 dataset_roots/index_path。需安装已声明的运行依赖和本地高斯光栅化扩展。仅传图像列表时使用合成基线。PLY 导出归一化几何、DC 颜色和标准透明度 logit。

Upstream terms restrict RollingForcing to academic use and prohibit commercial or production use.

paper.title: Rolling Forcing: Autoregressive Long Video Diffusion in Real Time
paper.abstract: Streaming video generation, as one fundamental component in interactive world models and neural game engines, aims to generate high-quality, low-latency, and temporally coherent long video streams. However, most existing work suffers from severe error accumulation that often significantly degrades the generated stream videos over long horizons. We design Rolling Forcing, a novel video generation technique that enables streaming long videos with minimal error accumulation. Rolling Forcing comes with three novel designs. First, instead of iteratively sampling individual frames, which accelerates error propagation, we design a joint denoising scheme that simultaneously denoises multiple frames with progressively increasing noise levels. This design relaxes the strict causality across adjacent frames, effectively suppressing error growth. Second, we introduce the attention sink mechanism int

paper.title: SANA-WM: Efficient Minute-Scale World Modeling with Hybrid Linear Diffusion Transformer
paper.abstract: We introduce SANA-WM, an efficient 2.6B-parameter open-source world model natively trained for one-minute generation, synthesizing high-fidelity, 720p, minute-scale videos with precise camera control. SANA-WM achieves visual quality comparable to large-scale industrial baselines such as LingBot-World and HY-WorldPlay, while significantly improving efficiency. Four core designs drive our architecture: (1) Hybrid Linear Attention combines frame-wise Gated DeltaNet (GDN) with softmax attention for memory-efficient long-context modeling. (2) Dual-Branch Camera Control ensures precise 6-DoF trajectory adherence. (3) Two-Stage Generation Pipeline applies a long-video refiner to stage-1 outputs, improving quality and consistency across sequences. (4) Robust Annotation Pipeline extracts accurate metric-scale 6-DoF camera poses from public videos to yield high-quality, spatiotemporally consistent

paper.title: Self Forcing: Bridging the Train-Test Gap in Autoregressive Video Diffusion
paper.abstract: We introduce Self Forcing, a novel training paradigm for autoregressive video diffusion models. It addresses the longstanding issue of exposure bias, where models trained on ground-truth context must generate sequences conditioned on their own imperfect outputs during inference. Unlike prior methods that denoise future frames based on ground-truth context frames, Self Forcing conditions each frame's generation on previously self-generated outputs by performing autoregressive rollout with key-value (KV) caching during training. This strategy enables supervision through a holistic loss at the video level that directly evaluates the quality of the entire generated sequence, rather than relying solely on traditional frame-wise objectives. To ensure training efficiency, we employ a few-step diffusion model along with a stochastic gradient truncation strategy, effectively balancing computation

recipes.summary: Stable Video Infinity 2.0 (SVI) generates arbitrarily long videos by chaining clips with five-frame continuation and per-clip seed changes, driven by prompt streams. This is one of the strongest evidence entries in the catalog: runner stat…

notes: The runtime uses SVI 2.0's official five-motion-frame continuation and full reference padding defaults.
The official 999-clip cap is bounded to two clips per prompt unless use_first_prompt_only is explicitly enabled.
Each clip receives a distinct seed by default; prompt streams repeat each prompt twice before advancing.
The source tree contains inference code only. Wan and SVI weights are resolved from local checkpoint staging.

A full Workspace default run on an A100 loaded all seven Wan2.1-I2V-14B DiT shards, T5, CLIP, the FP32 VAE path, and all 400 released SVI 2.0 LoRA pairs. It generated two linked 81-frame, 50-step clips and removed the five-frame overlap to produce 157 frames at 832x544 and 24 FPS.

The 157-frame H.264 artifact fully decoded to a finite uint8 array. Its SHA256 is 987a9fe3d938ed835ac6d64e45acb5921520741d51e8075b24aa1fe0d9320ee9; the segment seam temporal MAE is 7.58, 0.9% above the official native clip's observed 7.51 maximum frame delta.

An exact-setting 81-frame comparison against the pinned official runtime reached 31.03 dB PSNR, 4.05 pixel MAE, and 0.993 luma correlation. The fixed single-clip artifact SHA256 is 7a5b542ec863180ef96a4ac478c6e557fa72613025d5223f09108c62e1e41b1e.
Hopper, Blackwell, and lower-memory offload configurations are explicit runtime targets, not hardware-validated claims.
The official project reports A100 80GB, CUDA 12, and Torch 2.4-2.8 testing; WorldFoundry uses its shared cu128 runtime.
FlashAttention 2.8 can be installed as an optimization, but the in-tree attention dispatcher has supported fallbacks.

paper.title: Stable Video Infinity: Infinite-Length Video Generation with Error Recycling
paper.abstract: We propose Stable Video Infinity (SVI) that is able to generate infinite-length videos with high temporal consistency, plausible scene transitions, and controllable streaming storylines. While existing long-video methods attempt to mitigate accumulated errors via handcrafted anti-drifting (e.g., modified noise scheduler, frame anchoring), they remain limited to single-prompt extrapolation, producing homogeneous scenes with repetitive motions. We identify that the fundamental challenge extends beyond error accumulation to a critical discrepancy between the training assumption (seeing clean data) and the test-time autoregressive reality (conditioning on self-generated, error-prone outputs). To bridge this hypothesis gap, SVI incorporates Error-Recycling Fine-Tuning, a new type of efficient training that recycles the Diffusion Transformer (DiT)'s self-generated errors into supervisory promp

paper.title: Stable Virtual Camera: Generative View Synthesis with Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: We present Stable Virtual Camera (Seva), a generalist diffusion model that creates novel views of a scene, given any number of input views and target cameras. Existing works struggle to generate either large viewpoint changes or temporally smooth samples, while relying on specific task configurations. Our approach overcomes these limitations through simple model design, optimized training recipe, and flexible sampling strategy that generalize across view synthesis tasks at test time. As a result, our samples maintain high consistency without requiring additional 3D representation-based distillation, thus streamlining view synthesis in the wild. Furthermore, we show that our method can generate high-quality videos lasting up to half a minute with seamless loop closure. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates that Seva outperforms existing methods across different datasets and settings. Projec

paper.title: T2V-Turbo: Breaking the Quality Bottleneck of Video Consistency Model with Mixed Reward Feedback
paper.abstract: Diffusion-based text-to-video (T2V) models have achieved significant success but continue to be hampered by the slow sampling speed of their iterative sampling processes. To address the challenge, consistency models have been proposed to facilitate fast inference, albeit at the cost of sample quality. In this work, we aim to break the quality bottleneck of a video consistency model (VCM) to achieve $\textbf{both fast and high-quality video generation}$. We introduce T2V-Turbo, which integrates feedback from a mixture of differentiable reward models into the consistency distillation (CD) process of a pre-trained T2V model. Notably, we directly optimize rewards associated with single-step generations that arise naturally from computing the CD loss, effectively bypassing the memory constraints imposed by backpropagating gradients through an iterative sampling process. usageNotes: The catalog marks this entry as integrated: the hosted-API Studio pipeline is available, but you must supply your own provider API key and account. Keys are issued via Alibaba Cloud DashScope (dashscope.aliyun.com).

architecture: VACE adds a video-condition-and-editing context branch to the Wan2.1 DiT. Native defaults preserve the official VACE-14B inference shape: 1280x720, 81 frames, 50 steps, guidance scale 5.0. Both the 14B checkpoint and the 1.3B diffusers variant are recorded.

architecture: Per the paper (arXiv 2312.03884), an LLM proposes upcoming scene descriptions, a point-cloud-and-inpainting visual module renders each new scene from the previous one, and a VLM verifies results. Missing assets or runtime dependencies are reported at inference time.

paper.title: WonderJourney: Going from Anywhere to Everywhere
paper.abstract: We introduce WonderJourney, a modularized framework for perpetual 3D scene generation. Unlike prior work on view generation that focuses on a single type of scenes, we start at any user-provided location (by a text description or an image) and generate a journey through a long sequence of diverse yet coherently connected 3D scenes. We leverage an LLM to generate textual descriptions of the scenes in this journey, a text-driven point cloud generation pipeline to make a compelling and coherent sequence of 3D scenes, and a large VLM to verify the generated scenes. We show compelling, diverse visual results across various scene types and styles, forming imaginary "wonderjourneys". Project website: https://kovenyu.com/WonderJourney/

paper.title: WorldGen: From Text to Traversable and Interactive 3D Worlds
paper.abstract: We introduce WorldGen, a system that enables the automatic creation of large-scale, interactive 3D worlds directly from text prompts. Our approach transforms natural language descriptions into traversable, fully textured environments that can be immediately explored or edited within standard game engines. By combining LLM-driven scene layout reasoning, procedural generation, diffusion-based 3D generation, and object-aware scene decomposition, WorldGen bridges the gap between creative intent and functional virtual spaces, allowing creators to design coherent, navigable worlds without manual modeling or specialized 3D expertise. The system is fully modular and supports fine-grained control over layout, scale, and style, producing worlds that are geometrically consistent, visually rich, and efficient to render in real time. recipes.name: Causal-rCM
recipes.summary: Causal-rCM applies NVIDIA's rCM consistency distillation to causal video generation: it streams video autoregressively over latent-frame chunks with distilled few-step sampling, making it a low-latency interactive world-model candidate.

notes: Causal-rCM generates autoregressively over latent-frame chunks. first_chunk_t and chunk_t select the schedule; the c1-1 frame-wise setting gives the lowest streaming latency and c3-3 more throughput.
The released causal entrypoint is prompt and image conditioned. It exposes no discrete action space, so the input schema declares no actions; the chunk schedule is the streaming control surface.
Distilled few-step sampling is the default (`distilled=True`, 4 steps, mid_t 15/16 5/6 5/8). Setting distilled=False samples the multi-step causal-diffusion teacher with CFG instead.
Setting context_from_last_step=True caches the final denoising forward as the next chunk's context, saving one clean forward pass per chunk. Use it only with a checkpoint trained for noisy context.

Set kv_cache_policy=sliding_window to cap the causal cache at kv_cache_window_blocks (with optional kv_cache_sink_blocks) and allocate only the retained prefix plus one in-flight chunk. The default keep_all policy reproduces the upstream unbounded cache bit-for-bit. RoPE-remapping cache policies stay out of this post-RoPE entrypoint and require the separate extrapolation path.
The upstream imaginaire package is not vendored. WorldFoundry's lazy_config, easy_io, rank-aware logging, and selective activation checkpointing back the vendored runtime instead.
Covers only the vendored causal inference path. Upstream's training extras (megatron-core, transformer_engine, wandb, webdataset, fvcore, hydra-core) are intentionally omitted.
FlashAttention is optional. The vendored attention module dispatches on compute capability and falls back to PyTorch SDPA (cuDNN / FA2 / mem-efficient) when FlashAttention 3 is absent.
MagiAttention is optional and only used when RCM_ATTENTION_BACKEND=magi is set.
Upstream validated torch 2.11 on CUDA 12.6; the exact pin keeps this runtime isolated from the shared WorldFoundry environment.

notes: WorldFoundry vendors the official Apache-2.0 causal inference stack under synthesis/visual_generation/rcm/rcm_runtime; the adapter owns checkpoint gating, command construction, and pipeline/catalog exposure.
The upstream `imaginaire` framework package is not vendored. WorldFoundry's own lazy_config, easy_io, rank-aware logging, and selective activation checkpointing back the vendored code.

BlockPattern/AttnMaskSpec and the block-causal and teacher-forcing mask predicates were lifted into worldfoundry/core/attention/sparse/block_pattern.py so causal chunk schedules are one shared primitive.
The pipeline resolves the vendored causal entrypoint and returns blocked runtime diagnostics until the DiT, VAE, and text-encoder checkpoints are staged.
Extracted block-mask primitives are verified against the upstream implementation across 702 mask configurations and 162 chunk-schedule configurations.
Causal-rCM generates autoregressively over latent-frame chunks. first_chunk_t and chunk_t select the schedule; the c1-1 frame-wise setting gives the lowest streaming latency and c3-3 more throughput.
The released causal entrypoint is prompt and image conditioned. It exposes no discrete action space, so the input schema declares no actions; the chunk schedule is the streaming control surface.
Distilled few-step sampling is the default (`distilled=True`, 4 steps, mid_t 15/16 5/6 5/8). Setting distilled=False samples the multi-step causal-diffusion teacher with CFG instead.
Setting context_from_last_step=True caches the final denoising forward as the next chunk's context, saving one clean forward pass per chunk. Use it only with a checkpoint trained for noisy context.

Set kv_cache_policy=sliding_window to cap the causal cache at kv_cache_window_blocks (with optional kv_cache_sink_blocks) and allocate only the retained prefix plus one in-flight chunk. The default keep_all policy reproduces the upstream unbounded cache bit-for-bit. RoPE-remapping cache policies stay out of this post-RoPE entrypoint and require the separate extrapolation path.
The upstream imaginaire package is not vendored. WorldFoundry's lazy_config, easy_io, rank-aware logging, and selective activation checkpointing back the vendored runtime instead.

overview: Causal-rCM applies NVIDIA's rCM consistency distillation to causal video generation: it streams video autoregressively over latent-frame chunks with distilled few-step sampling, making it a low-latency interactive world-model candidate. In this catalog the official Apache-2.0 causal inference stack is vendored in-tree; execution waits on the public DiT, Wan2.1 VAE, and umT5 checkpoints being staged locally.
overviewZh: Causal-rCM 把英伟达的 rCM 一致性蒸馏应用于因果视频生成：以潜帧 chunk 为单位自回归流式生成，配合蒸馏的少步采样，是低延迟交互式世界模型的候选。本 catalog 中官方 Apache-2.0 因果推理栈已内置树内；执行待公开 DiT、Wan2.1 VAE 与 umT5 checkpoint 本地就位。
architecture: Per the paper (arXiv 2510.08431), rCM combines score-regularized consistency distillation for few-step sampling. The vendored stack drops the upstream imaginaire framework — WorldFoundry's own lazy_config, easy_io, and logging back it — and the block-causal mask predicates were lifted into worldfoundry/core/attention/sparse/block_pattern.py, verified against upstream across 702 mask and 162 chunk-schedule configurations.
architectureZh: 按论文（arXiv 2510.08431），rCM 结合分数正则化的一致性蒸馏实现少步采样。内置栈去掉了上游 imaginaire 框架——由 WorldFoundry 自有的 lazy_config、easy_io 与日志支撑——块因果掩码谓词提取到 worldfoundry/core/attention/sparse/block_pattern.py，并在 702 种掩码与 162 种 chunk 调度配置下对照上游验证。
usageNotes: first_chunk_t and chunk_t select the schedule: c1-1 frame-wise gives the lowest streaming latency, c3-3 more throughput. Distilled 4-step sampling is the default; distilled=False samples the multi-step teacher with CFG. context_from_last_step=True saves one clean forward per chunk but requires a checkpoint trained for noisy context. The released entrypoint is prompt/image conditioned with no discrete action space.
usageNotesZh: first_chunk_t 与 chunk_t 选择调度：c1-1 逐帧模式流式延迟最低，c3-3 吞吐更高。默认使用蒸馏的 4 步采样；distilled=False 则以 CFG 采样多步教师。context_from_last_step=True 每 chunk 省一次干净前向，但要求 checkpoint 针对带噪上下文训练。发布的入口为提示词/图像条件，无离散动作空间。

paper.title: Large Scale Diffusion Distillation via Score-Regularized Continuous-Time Consistency
paper.abstract: Although continuous-time consistency models (e.g., sCM, MeanFlow) are theoretically principled and empirically powerful for fast academic-scale diffusion, its applicability to large-scale text-to-image and video tasks remains unclear due to infrastructure challenges in Jacobian-vector product (JVP) computation and the limitations of evaluation benchmarks like FID. This work represents the first effort to scale up continuous-time consistency to general application-level image and video diffusion models, and to make JVP-based distillation effective at large scale. We first develop a parallelism-compatible FlashAttention-2 JVP kernel, enabling sCM training on models with over 10 billion parameters and high-dimensional video tasks. Our investigation reveals fundamental quality limitations of sCM in fine-detail generation, which we attribute to error accumulation and the "mode-covering" natur

overview: Ctrl-World is a controllable generative world model for robot manipulation: conditioned on robot actions, it predicts future observation video so policies can be evaluated or improved inside the model. The vendored source completed a local checkpoint-backed five-frame synthetic-three-view inference at the released 25-step sampler default; real synchronized robot views are still needed to assess action quality.
overviewZh: Ctrl-World 是面向机器人操作的可控生成式世界模型：以机器人动作为条件预测未来观测视频，使策略可以在模型内被评估或改进。内置源码与本地权重已按官方默认 25 步完成合成三视角的五帧推理；评估动作质量仍需真实同步机器人视角。
architecture: The recorded checkpoints tell the design: a Stable Video Diffusion image-to-video backbone (stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid) with CLIP conditioning (openai/clip-vit-base-patch32) and Ctrl-World's own action-conditioning weights (yjguo/Ctrl-World). Internals beyond this are not recorded in this repository.
architectureZh: 记录的 checkpoint 揭示其设计：Stable Video Diffusion 图生视频基座（stabilityai/stable-video-diffusion-img2vid）、CLIP 条件（openai/clip-vit-base-patch32），加上 Ctrl-World 自有的动作条件权重（yjguo/Ctrl-World）。除此之外的内部细节仓库未记录。
usageNotes: The pipeline requires the Ctrl-World, SVD, and CLIP checkpoints and synchronized three-view inputs. A single-image synthetic-three-view mode is available only for smoke validation; use the released 25-step sampler default for normal inference.
usageNotesZh: pipeline 需要 Ctrl-World、SVD、CLIP 权重及同步的三视角输入。单图合成三视角模式只适合冒烟验证；正常推理应使用官方默认的 25 步采样。

overview: CUT3R is a continuous 3D perception model with persistent state: it ingests a stream of images and continuously updates a metric-scale 3D reconstruction, without offline bundling. In this catalog the in-tree point-cloud and two-stage 3DGS routes are registered through Studio discovery. CUT3R also serves as the geometry backbone for the verified VMem entry in the video category.
overviewZh: CUT3R 是带持久状态的连续 3D 感知模型：接收图像流并持续更新米制尺度的 3D 重建，无需离线捆绑优化。本 catalog 中已通过 Studio 发现机制注册了树内点云与两段式 3DGS 路径。CUT3R 同时是 video 类别中已验证的 VMem 条目的几何主干。
architecture: A recurrent transformer maintains a persistent scene state; each new frame updates the state and outputs pointmaps and camera parameters online (per the upstream publication). The recorded routes cover raw point-cloud export and a two-stage 3DGS pipeline; weights are apache-2.0.
architectureZh: 循环 Transformer 维护持久场景状态；每帧新图像更新状态并在线输出点图与相机参数（见上游论文）。已记录路径覆盖点云导出与两段式 3DGS pipeline；权重为 apache-2.0。
usageNotes: Runner parity is pending: checkpoint-backed inference depends on staged local or Hugging Face cut3r weights. Stage them before submitting Studio jobs.
usageNotesZh: Runner parity 为 pending：checkpoint 加载推理依赖就位的本地或 Hugging Face cut3r 权重。提交 Studio 任务前请先就位权重。
limitations: Checkpoint-backed parity is pending; the routes are registered but unverified in this workspace.
Streaming reconstruction quality degrades on long sequences with severe viewpoint changes.
limitationsZh: checkpoint 加载一致性待验证；路径已注册但本工作区尚未验证。

paper.title: Dexora: Open-source VLA for High-DoF Bimanual Dexterity
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently become a central direction in embodied AI, but current systems are restricted to either dual-gripper control or single-arm dexterous hand manipulation. While low-dimensional gripper control can often be handled with simpler methods, high-dimensional dexterous hand control benefits greatly from full end-to-end VLA learning. In this work, we introduce Dexora, the first open-source VLA system that natively targets dual-arm, dual-hand high-DoF manipulation. We design a hybrid teleoperation pipeline that decouples gross arm kinematics (captured with a custom exoskeleton backpack) from fine finger motion (markerless hand tracking via Apple Vision Pro), and that drives both a physical dual-arm dual-hand platform and an identical MuJoCo digital twin. Using that interface, we assemble a large training corpus: an embodiment-matched synthetic corpus

The discrete checkpoint can be selected with hma_checkpoint_dir and requires the official MAGVIT2 tokenizer at source/data/magvit2.ckpt or hma_magvit_checkpoint.

paper.title: Learning Real-World Action-Video Dynamics with Heterogeneous Masked Autoregression
paper.abstract: We propose Heterogeneous Masked Autoregression (HMA) for modeling action-video dynamics to generate high-quality data and evaluation in scaling robot learning. Building interactive video world models and policies for robotics is difficult due to the challenge of handling diverse settings while maintaining computational efficiency to run in real time. HMA uses heterogeneous pre-training from observations and action sequences across different robotic embodiments, domains, and tasks. HMA uses masked autoregression to generate quantized or soft tokens for video predictions. \ourshort achieves better visual fidelity and controllability than the previous robotic video generation models with 15 times faster speed in the real world. After post-training, this model can be used as a video simulator from low-level action inputs for evaluating policies and generating synthetic data. See this link ht

paper.title: Streaming 4D Visual Geometry Transformer
paper.abstract: Perceiving and reconstructing 3D geometry from videos is a fundamental yet challenging computer vision task. To facilitate interactive and low-latency applications, we propose a streaming visual geometry transformer that shares a similar philosophy with autoregressive large language models. We explore a simple and efficient design and employ a causal transformer architecture to process the input sequence in an online manner. We use temporal causal attention and cache the historical keys and values as implicit memory to enable efficient streaming long-term 3D reconstruction. This design can handle low-latency 3D reconstruction by incrementally integrating historical information while maintaining high-quality spatial consistency. paper.title: MineWorld: a Real-Time and Open-Source Interactive World Model on Minecraft
paper.abstract: World modeling is a crucial task for enabling intelligent agents to effectively interact with humans and operate in dynamic environments. In this work, we propose MineWorld, a real-time interactive world model on Minecraft, an open-ended sandbox game which has been utilized as a common testbed for world modeling. MineWorld is driven by a visual-action autoregressive Transformer, which takes paired game scenes and corresponding actions as input, and generates consequent new scenes following the actions. Specifically, by transforming visual game scenes and actions into discrete token ids with an image tokenizer and an action tokenizer correspondingly, we consist the model input with the concatenation of the two kinds of ids interleaved. paper.title: Training Agents Inside of Scalable World Models
paper.abstract: World models learn general knowledge from videos and simulate experience for training behaviors in imagination, offering a path towards intelligent agents. However, previous world models have been unable to accurately predict object interactions in complex environments. We introduce Dreamer 4, a scalable agent that learns to solve control tasks by reinforcement learning inside of a fast and accurate world model. In the complex video game Minecraft, the world model accurately predicts object interactions and game mechanics, outperforming previous world models by a large margin. The world model achieves real-time interactive inference on a single GPU through a shortcut forcing objective and an efficient transformer architecture. paper.title: $π^3$: Permutation-Equivariant Visual Geometry Learning
paper.abstract: We introduce $π^3$, a feed-forward neural network that offers a novel approach to visual geometry reconstruction, breaking the reliance on a conventional fixed reference view. Previous methods often anchor their reconstructions to a designated viewpoint, an inductive bias that can lead to instability and failures if the reference is suboptimal. In contrast, $π^3$ employs a fully permutation-equivariant architecture to predict affine-invariant camera poses and scale-invariant local point maps without any reference frames. This design not only makes our model inherently robust to input ordering, but also leads to higher accuracy and performance. These advantages enable our simple and bias-free approach to achieve state-of-the-art performance on a wide range of tasks, including camera pose estimation, monocular/video depth estimation, and dense point map reconstruction. paper.title: SANA: Efficient High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Linear Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: We introduce Sana, a text-to-image framework that can efficiently generate images up to 4096$\times$4096 resolution. Sana can synthesize high-resolution, high-quality images with strong text-image alignment at a remarkably fast speed, deployable on laptop GPU. Core designs include: (1) Deep compression autoencoder: unlike traditional AEs, which compress images only 8$\times$, we trained an AE that can compress images 32$\times$, effectively reducing the number of latent tokens. (2) Linear DiT: we replace all vanilla attention in DiT with linear attention, which is more efficient at high resolutions without sacrificing quality. (3) Decoder-only text encoder: we replaced T5 with modern decoder-only small LLM as the text encoder and designed complex human instruction with in-context learning to enhance the image-text alignment. (4) Efficient training and sampling: we propose Flow-DPM-Solver

paper.title: VGGT-World: Transforming VGGT into an Autoregressive Geometry World Model
paper.abstract: World models that forecast scene evolution by generating future video frames devote the bulk of their capacity to photometric details, yet the resulting predictions often remain geometrically inconsistent. We present VGGT-World, a geometry world model that side-steps video generation entirely and instead forecasts the temporal evolution of frozen geometry-foundation-model (GFM) features. Concretely, we repurpose the latent tokens of a frozen VGGT as the world state and train a lightweight temporal flow transformer to autoregressively predict their future trajectory. Two technical challenges arise in this high-dimensional (d=1024) feature space: (i) standard velocity-prediction flow matching collapses, and (ii) autoregressive rollout suffers from compounding exposure bias. We address the first with a clean-target (z-prediction) parameterization that yields a substantially higher signal-to
