paper.title: WorldMem: Long-term Consistent World Simulation with Memory
paper.abstract: World simulation has gained increasing popularity due to its ability to model virtual environments and predict the consequences of actions. However, the limited temporal context window often leads to failures in maintaining long-term consistency, particularly in preserving 3D spatial consistency. In this work, we present WorldMem, a framework that enhances scene generation with a memory bank consisting of memory units that store memory frames and states (e.g., poses and timestamps). By employing a memory attention mechanism that effectively extracts relevant information from these memory frames based on their states, our method is capable of accurately reconstructing previously observed scenes, even under significant viewpoint or temporal gaps. Setting generate_world with a world_video_path continues to 50 steps and writes the decoded future-view mosaic; run_depth adds the depth branch.

overview: OpenVLA-OFT applies optimized fine-tuning to OpenVLA — parallel decoding, continuous action heads, and chunking — and is fully GPU-validated in this catalog: an A100 restored all 7.54B parameters, produced deterministic finite 8x7 action chunks across multiple inputs at 14.47 GiB peak VRAM, and all five declared LIBERO checkpoints completed real inference (MIT license).
overviewZh: OpenVLA-OFT 对 OpenVLA 施加优化微调——并行解码、连续动作头与动作分块——并在本 catalog 中完成 GPU 验证：A100 恢复全部 75.4 亿参数，对多组输入产出确定性的有限 8x7 动作块，峰值显存 14.47 GiB，五个声明的 LIBERO checkpoint 全部完成真实推理（MIT 许可）。
architecture: The OFT recipe replaces autoregressive token decoding with parallel decoding plus an L1 continuous action head and 8-step chunking over the 7B OpenVLA backbone, with proprio and noisy-action projectors in-tree. Attention is hardware-resolved: FlashAttention 2 on Ampere/Ada/Hopper, PyTorch SDPA fallback elsewhere including Blackwell.
architectureZh: OFT 配方在 7B OpenVLA 骨干上以并行解码替换自回归 token 解码，加 L1 连续动作头与 8 步分块，本体感知与噪声动作投影器内置树内。注意力按硬件解析：Ampere/Ada/Hopper 用 FlashAttention 2，其他架构（含 Blackwell）回退 PyTorch SDPA。
usageNotes: Pick the LIBERO suite checkpoint matching your split (spatial, object, goal, etc.); official LIBERO observation inputs are supported directly. Training, RLDS processing, TensorFlow tooling, and LIBERO benchmark loops are excluded.

paper.title: X-VLA: Soft-Prompted Transformer as Scalable Cross-Embodiment Vision-Language-Action Model
paper.abstract: Successful generalist Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely on effective training across diverse robotic platforms with large-scale, cross-embodiment, heterogeneous datasets. To facilitate and leverage the heterogeneity in rich, diverse robotic data sources, we propose a novel Soft Prompt approach with minimally added parameters, by infusing prompt learning concepts into cross-embodiment robot learning and introducing separate sets of learnable embeddings for each distinct data source. These embeddings serve as embodiment-specific prompts, which in unity empower VLA models with effective exploitation of varying cross-embodiment features. Our new X-VLA, a neat flow-matching-based VLA architecture, relies exclusively on soft-prompted standard Transformer encoders, enjoying both scalability and simplicity. overview: IRASim (Interactive Real-Robot Action Simulator) generates realistic robot-arm videos from an initial frame plus an action trajectory — a learned simulator for robot data. In this catalog the model, diffusion, and inference pipeline modules are vendored in-tree; real generation waits on manually staged official checkpoint archives.
overviewZh: IRASim（交互式真实机器人动作模拟器）从初始帧加动作轨迹生成逼真的机械臂视频——机器人数据的学习型模拟器。本 catalog 中其模型、扩散与推理 pipeline 模块已内置树内；真实生成待手动就位官方 checkpoint 归档。
architecture: Per the upstream release, a DiT video diffusion model conditions on per-frame action tokens for trajectory-accurate robot video. Training dataloaders, evaluation scripts, and interactive demos are pruned from the packaged runtime under synthesis/visual_generation/irasim/irasim_runtime.
architectureZh: 按上游发布，DiT 视频扩散模型以逐帧动作 token 为条件，生成轨迹精确的机器人视频。打包在 synthesis/visual_generation/irasim/irasim_runtime 的运行时已裁剪训练数据加载器、评估脚本与交互 demo。
usageNotes: Published checkpoint archives are not HF model repos staged by the current downloader — supply checkpoints and task fixtures manually before expecting real video.
usageNotesZh: 发布的 checkpoint 归档不是当前下载器支持的 HF 模型仓库——期望得到真实视频前请手动提供 checkpoint 与任务 fixture。

overviewZh: Pandora 是较早的通用世界模型，采用自然语言动作与视频状态：把世界状态模拟成视频，并允许在任意步骤用自由文本动作操控模拟。本 catalog 中其模型、ChatUniVi 与 DynamiCrafter 运行时模块已内置树内；由于官方权重因数据许可限制未公开，完整生成保持 blocked。
architecture: Per the upstream release, an autoregressive LLM backbone (ChatUniVi-family) connects to a video diffusion decoder (DynamiCrafter-family) so language actions steer video-state rollouts. The vendored runtime lives under synthesis/visual_generation/pandora/pandora_runtime.
architectureZh: 按上游发布，自回归 LLM 主干（ChatUniVi 系）连接视频扩散解码器（DynamiCrafter 系），使语言动作操控视频状态滚动。内置运行时位于 synthesis/visual_generation/pandora/pandora_runtime。
usageNotes: PandoraSynthesis provides a runtime-plan wrapper; real generation requires caller-provided official-compatible checkpoints, since official weights are hidden or unavailable.
